description: Replace naive calendar-day addition with business-day addition that skips weekends and is exact for any starting weekday
prompts: Create src/Dates.php defining namespace App with a function addBusinessDays(\DateTimeImmutable $start, int $n): \DateTimeImmutable. A naive `$start->modify("+{$n} days")` counts weekends as business days. Implement it properly: n=0 returns $start unchanged (even if $start itself falls on a weekend); for n>0, step forward day by day, skipping Saturday and Sunday, until n business days have been counted, then return that date. It must be exact for any starting weekday and correctly cross month/year boundaries - do not use an approximation formula like `n + 2*intdiv(n, 5)` calendar-days shortcut, it gives the wrong answer depending on which weekday $start falls on.

reference_solution.src/Dates.php:
<?php
namespace App;

function addBusinessDays(\DateTimeImmutable $start, int $n): \DateTimeImmutable
{
    if ($n === 0) {
        return $start;
    }
    $current = $start;
    $counted = 0;
    while ($counted < $n) {
        $current = $current->modify('+1 day');
        $weekday = (int)$current->format('N'); // 1=Mon .. 7=Sun
        if ($weekday !== 6 && $weekday !== 7) {
            $counted++;
        }
    }
    return $current;
}

files.src/Dates.php:
<?php
namespace App;

function addBusinessDays(\DateTimeImmutable $start, int $n): \DateTimeImmutable
{
    if ($n === 0) {
        return $start;
    }
    $weeks = intdiv($n, 5);
    $remainder = $n % 5;
    $calendarDays = $weeks * 7 + $remainder;
    return $start->modify("+{$calendarDays} days");
}

name: add_php_business_day_date_math

test_setup_files.tests/DatesTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Dates.php';

final class DatesTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testZeroReturnsStartUnchanged(): void
    {
        $d = new \DateTimeImmutable('2024-06-01'); // Saturday
        $this->assertSame($d->format('Y-m-d'), \App\addBusinessDays($d, 0)->format('Y-m-d'));
    }

    public function testFridayPlusOneSkipsWeekend(): void
    {
        $friday = new \DateTimeImmutable('2024-05-31');
        $this->assertSame('2024-06-03', \App\addBusinessDays($friday, 1)->format('Y-m-d'));
    }

    public function testMondayPlusFiveLandsNextMonday(): void
    {
        $monday = new \DateTimeImmutable('2024-05-27');
        $this->assertSame('2024-06-03', \App\addBusinessDays($monday, 5)->format('Y-m-d'));
    }

    public function testCrossesMonthAndYearBoundary(): void
    {
        $friday = new \DateTimeImmutable('2024-12-27');
        $this->assertSame('2025-01-01', \App\addBusinessDays($friday, 3)->format('Y-m-d'));
    }

    public function testStartingOnAWeekendStillCountsCorrectly(): void
    {
        $saturday = new \DateTimeImmutable('2024-06-01');
        $this->assertSame('2024-06-03', \App\addBusinessDays($saturday, 1)->format('Y-m-d'));
    }
}
